#### **Executive Summary** 

#### **Highlights of international copper market** 

The Europe credit crisis has been eased gradually since June this year. US dollar stopped to go soft again. The global monetary market continued to be a loose condition while the market was still expected to face the inflation. The main world economic figures were better than expectation. Copper price increased greatly in Q3 though it was the traditional off season. The price reached a yearly record high in late September and stand above USD 8,000/t. 

LME copper price and copper stock had very high negative correlation before mid‐2009. Copper price increased

or decreased all in line with the decrease or increase of copper stock. However, such a relationship was gone in the second half of 2009, indicating that the people were more focus on the demand future than the copper market fundamentals. The negative correlation was resumed gradually since February this year. #### **Highlights of Chinese copper market** Domestic copper price was relatively weak during the same period. The RMB against US dollar appreciated rapidly during Jun‐Sep, giving heavy pressure to the domestic copper price. The market confidence was also weakened. The price was facing great underselling at RMB 60,000 yuan/t. The price ratio against LME copper was diminishing to lower than 7.6. SHFE copper stock turned up a decreasing trend, to 87.4kt at the end of September, down by 40kt against Q2. Continuing drop of copper stock provided solid base for the rising of copper price. #### **Chinese Copper Price** #### **Copper price jumps high and drops back** The Europe credit crisis has been eased gradually since June this year. anges was going differently in Q3. Open interest of SHFE dropped back, while the open interest of LME and Comex rebounded. By the end of September, LME open interest increased to 283 thousand lots after 5‐month’s decline. Comex open interest increased gradually to 143 thousand lots in late September. The rebound of open interest at the two Exchanges gave enough support to the rising of copper price. SHFE open interest reached 196 thousand lots in July and then dropped back to 145 thousand lots by the end of September. **Chart 1 Open Interest on World’s Top Three Nonferrous Metals Exchanges SHFE, Comex stocks rebound** SHFE LME COMEX

**Both LME, SHFE stocks fall** LME copper stock maintained the decreasing trend in Q3 2010, to 373.8kt in late September, drop by 75.6kt or 16.8% against March. Meanwhile, SHFE copper stock turned up a decreasing trend, to 87.4kt at the end of September, down by 40kt against Q2. Continuing drop of copper stock provided solid base for the rising of copper price. LME copper price and copper stock had very high negative correlation before mid‐2009. Copper price increased or decreased all in line with the decrease or increase of copper stock. However, such a relationship was gone in the second half of 2009, indicating that the people were more focus on the demand future than the copper market fundamentals. The negative correlation was resumed gradually since February this year. **Chart 2 Inventory and 3‐m Copper Price on LME** kt US

#### **Global copper demand drop back in Q3** The global copper consumption fell back in Q3 compared with Q2 as it was in the traditional off season. However, demand increased greatly year on year. The consumption in Q3 was 4.4mlnt, down by 4.76% q/q while up by 5.52% y/y. Meanwhile, the world copper output also declined against Q2, to 4.53mlnt. The world copper market was 130kt surplus in Q3. Seen from the main copper consumption countries (regions), China maintained the steady growth; Europe had walked out of the gloomy circumstance of 2009; The US market kept stable trend, but not seen obviously better change; Japan, South Korea and China Taiwan turned up to rebound. The world copper consumption was better than last year, and the surplus condition is expected to be narrowed in 2010. **Table 2 Global Refined Copper Market Balance in 2008‐2010 Unit: kt** ||2008|Q1|Q2|2009

#### **Chinese Copper Material Supply** #### **Mining expansion projects** By the end of 2009, Chinese copper concentrate (copper content) production capacity was about 1.2Mt/y. It is expected that Chinese copper concentrate (copper content) production capacity will reach 1.24Mt, 1.3Mt and 1.35Mt in 2010, 2011 and 2012 respectively. Chinese mining expansion projects since this year are as following: **Daye Nonferrous Metals Co., Ltd** ’s Tonglvshan Copper Mine’s expansion project was kicked off in June, 2010. It can add 8,000t/y of mined copper and prolong mine’s service life for 17 years. **Xinxin Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Huangshan Cu‐Ni Mine’s 4,000t/d project was kicked off in June, 2010. The mine locates in Hami City, Xinjiang with 84mlnt of Cu‐Ni ore reserves, including 380kt of nickel content, 220kt of copper content and 32kt of cobalt content. The project with total investment of 1bln yuan will be commissioned by the end of September, 201

1. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine has finished 7,500t/d expansion project by the end of June. Currently Dexing Copper Mine has mining capacity of 107.5kt/d. The 7,500t/d expansion project was invested in 360mln yuan and took 10 months to be commissioned. The total project with 130kt/d capacity is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment will reach 2.7bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will grow to 130kt/d from current 100kt. Outputs newly added will include 41kt copper‐in‐concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. 

**Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan will be constructed for 2 years, and it can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper. 

**Jiangxi Yinshan Mining Co., Ltd** ’s 5,000t/d project with total investment of 500mln yuan kicked off in January, 2010. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Yongping Copper Mine will finish transformation from underground into open pit project in March, 2010. 

Jiangxi Copper plans to produce 172kt of copper concentrate in 2010, with 5kt over the previous year. 

**Zinjin Mining Holdings Group Co., Ltd** ’s Zinjinshan Copper Mine will establish two mining plants which can process 10kt/d and 8,000t/d of ores respectively. And it will also establish a 45kt/d grinding system project. Zinjinshan Copper Mine with total investment of 500mln yuan will be commissioned in 2011. 

**Zinjinshan Copper Mine** is located in Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province. 

**Xinjiang Huajin Copper Co., Ltd** ’s Tuwu Copper Mine kicked off on February 25, 2010. Tuwu Copper Mine with total investment of 2bln yuan planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned in 2011 and it is designed to process 5,000t/d of ores. The second stage can process 10kt/d of ores. 

**Tibet Huatailong Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Jiama Copper Polymetallic Mine with total investment of 1.6bln yuan planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage has finished construction at present. It can process 6,000t/d of ores and produce 15ktpy of copper concentrate. 

**Jiama Copper Polymetallic Mine** is located in Mozhugongka County, Tibet. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper‐Molybdenum Mine** launched workshop construction in end‐May. Duobaoshan Mine is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total investment of 3.0 bln yuan and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned in 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day, and producing 117,648 t copper concentrates (25% Cu) and 1,401 t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year.  When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45%) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. 

**Duobaoshan Copper Mine** is located in

north of Nenjiang County, Heihe City, Heilongjiang Province. The resources identified are 9.47% Cu for 1.78 mln t of copper metal, 0.016% Mo for 57.4kt of molybdenum, 0.144g/t Au for 60.29t gold and 2.059g/t Ag for 777.08t of silver. 

**Duobaoshan Copper** is established in January 2006 with registered capital of 600 mln yuan. Its holding shareholder is Zijin Mining Group that owns 51% stock. Other shareholders are Heiongjiang Heilong Mining Co., Ltd. (37%owned), Heilongjiang Dilian Investment Co., Ltd (9% owned) and Harbin Baifu Investment Co., Ltd. (3%). 

#### **Latest Chinese mining projects overseas in 2010:** 

**Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd** (Zinjin Mining) announced in May, 2010 that it would invest 1.16bln yuan to purchase shares of Platmin with China‐Africa Development Fund (CAD Fund). 

－ Platmin owns 68% shares of Deziwa Cu‐Co Mine and E cailleC Cu‐Co Mine. Deziwa Cu‐Co － Mine owns 1.34mlntpy of copper content reserves and 131kt of cobalt content reserves. E cailleC Cu‐Co Mine is estimated to own 251kt of copper reserves and 13kt of cobalt reserves. According to research study report, the project with total investment of US$466mln can process 4.5mlntpy of ores, and it can produce 80ktpy of copper and 10ktpy of cobalt after it is commissioned. Its service life will be 20 years. 

**Chinalco** invested US$2.2bln into Toromocho Mine project in Peru, it is expected to be become Peru's largest copper mine. Chinalco invested US$860mln to purchase Peru CopperInc. (CUP) and the prospecting right of Toromocho Mine. Chinalco estimated the project will be commissioned in 2012and it can produce 250kt of copper each year. 

**Jinchuan Nonferrous Metals Group Limited** (JNMC) signed an agreement with Kazakhmys in April, 2010 to jointly deplore Aktogay Copper Mine in Kazakhstan. JNMC invested US$120mln in this project and owned 49% shares of the project. It is estimated that the project will produce 100ktpy of copper concentrate content and the service life will be 40 years. 

The project will be commissioned within 5 years at least. 

**Tongling Nonferrous Metals Group Holdings Co., Ltd** (TLYS) announced on May 31 that it spent C$4.27bln to purchase 96.9% shares of Corriente Resources Inc (Corriente) with China Railway Construction Co., Ltd (CRCC). 

Corriente is a Canadian‐based resource development and exploration company specializing 

in copper and copper‐gold opportunities. It owns 17 mineral rights of copper mine belt in Ecuador. The main capital of Corriente is the mineral rights of Mirador, Mirador Norte, San Carlos and Panantza Copper Mines. Total copper reserves of these four copper mines are 11.58mlnt. After the project is commissioned, it can process 54mlntpy of ores and produce 0.8‐1mlntpy of copper concentrate (contains 0.25‐0.3mlnt of copper content) 

**China Sci‐Tech Holdings Ltd** (China Sci‐Tech) plans to restart copper production at the Lady Annie Copper Mine in Australia in December 2010. 

China Sci‐Tech acquired the mine f

rom Cape Lambert Resources Ltd. earlier this month for A$135 million. 

Lady Annie currently has sufficient reserves and resources for around 4.5 years of operation at 25,000 metric tons of copper per year. 

Separately, the company also announced it has agreed to buy Canada‐listed Chariot Resources Ltd.’s 70% stake in Peru's Marcona Copper Property and the Mina Justa project for HK$1.8bln (US$232mln). 

Mina Justa's copper resources support annual output of around 100,000 metric tons of copper. 

The project would be commissioned in 2013, China Sci‐Tech said. 

**State Grid Corporation of China** (SGCC) signed an agreement with Quadra Mining to develop a large‐scale copper deposit in Chile in March. 

According to the agreement signed with Quadra, SGCC and Quadra will invest US$900mln to establish a new jointly venture company for developing Sierra Gorda project in the north of Chile. 

As a part of the agreement, SGCC will purchase 9.9% shares of Quadra with 1.42 cad (1.48US$). 

Sierra Gorda is located in Atacama Desert in Chile. It owns 989mlnt of ore reserves and its ore average grade contains 0.42% copper content, 0.027% molybdenum content and 0.069g/t gold. It is planned to produce 139ktpy of copper, 7.3ktpy of molybdenum and 36 ounces of gold. And its exploiting time will be 25 years. 

SGCC is the biggest copper consumer in the world. It mainly uses copper in wire and cable. 

**Xiangguang Copper Co., Ltd** (Xiangguang Copper), a copper smelting unit of chicken supplier Shandong Fengxiang Group is planning to acquire 15% stakes of Rocklands Copper Mine. Rocklands Copper Mine belongs to CuDeco. 

The Rocklands Mine, near Cloncurry, Queensland, will have a 10 year exploration time frame and an annual production capacity of 3 million tons. It is expected to generate about $960 million in revenue annually. 

Xiangguang Copper locates in the south of Shifo town, Yanggu County, Shandong Province, it is a large‐scale nonferrous smelter with a annul production of 400,000tons of cathode copper. 

**China Nonferrous Metal Mining Group Co., Ltd** (CNMC) will construct Muliashi Copper Mine. The reserves of Muliashi Copper Mine are estimated to be exploited for 15‐25 years. The project will be commissioned in 2012 and it can produce 60ktpy of copper. 

**The president of Jiangxi Copper Co., Ltd.** (JCCL) Mr. Liyihuang said that JCCL’s Afghan Aynak Copper Mine project would be commissioned in 2013‐14. The project will produce 190ktpy of metal in initial period. Afghan Aynak Copper Mine was developed jointly by China Metallurgical Group Corporation (MCC) and JCCL. MCC and JCCL hold 75% and 25% stakes of Afghan Aynak Copper Mine project. 

#### **Import of raw materials** 

Import of domestic main copper products increased and decreased in varying degrees in Q3 2010. Import of refined copper decreased to 752kt, down by 6.2% m‐o‐m; Import of copper blister kept increase trend and increased to 99kt, up by 11.5% q‐o‐q; Import of copper semis and copper con

centrate decreased to 231kt and 1.42Mt, down by 8.4% and 13.0% m‐o‐m; Import of copper scraps increased to 1.20Mt, up by 13.7% q‐o‐q. ##### Export of copper semis in Q3 decreased to 132kt, down by 8.6% q‐o‐q. In terms of the metal content, import of all copper raw materials increased in Q1‐Q3 2010 except refined copper, of which net import of copper blister ranked the first and increased largely to 110kt, then net import of copper scraps decreased to 71kt.
